LESSON: MY CREATION

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: question(s) Creation 1.1 Self- By the end of the Sub strand, the ● Learners to r
Topic 1.2: My Creation

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about My Creation. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify members of the extended family 4 lessons
2. appreciate members of the extended family for harmonious living
3. state items shared at home for family unity
4. state items that should not be shared at home for healthy living home

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify members of the extended family 4 lessons
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify members of the extended family 4 lessons. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate members of the extended family for harmonious living
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate members of the extended family for harmonious living. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. state items shared at home for family unity
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to state items shared at home for family unity. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. state items that should not be shared at home for healthy living home
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to state items that should not be shared at home for healthy living home. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about My Creation.
2. Explain My Creation to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand My Creation.
4. Show that you can: identify members of the extended family 4 lessons
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about My Creation. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is My Creation important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify members of the extended family 4 lessons
2. appreciate members of the extended family for harmonious living
3. state items shared at home for family unity
4. state items that should not be shared at home for healthy living home

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
